jobs.title: Head of Growth - BeReal
jobs.description:
ABOUT BEREAL

At BeReal, we are dedicated to authenticity in social media. By encouraging users to share unfiltered moments, we foster genuine connections and celebrate real life. We are now an international team of 100+ and have 40M+ monthly active users. Backed by Voodoo, our team is fully focused on scaling BeReal into an iconic social network used by hundreds of millions.




ROLE

As the Head of Growth, you will be responsible for scaling BeReal worldwide, reporting to the CEO and working closely with Voodoo’s central growth team.

You will build and lead a team of 3+ people to cover all growth activities. The ideal candidate is a data-driven leader with a structured mindset, a passion for growth, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic and entrepreneurial environment.

 - Build the growth strategy to scale BeReal’s user base. Drive the execution of all user acquisition channels (including paid UA, product-led growth, offline activities, partnerships, PR, content production, influencer marketing, organic growth, community management, ASO  and app store relationships.) 

 - Partner with cross-functional teams and product teams to ensure execution of the growth strategy and leverage resources effectively

 - Conduct systematic data analysis and leverage key metrics to measure channels performances, drive decision-making, prioritize growth initiatives and new opportunities.

 - Stay up-to-date with industry trends and competitors’ growth strategies to identify innovative activations




PROFILE

 - You have at least 3/4 years of experience, and a proven track record in driving growth for consumer-facing digital product, preferably in social media or mobile app

 - You understand the mobile growth ecosystem in detail as well as branding performance 

 - You are a data-driven, growth hacker with an entrepreneurial mindset and can adapt to a high-paced environment

 - You can demonstrate excellent teamwork and collaboration skills

 - You are fluent in English (fluency in French is a plus)




BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary upon experience

 - Swile Lunch voucher

 - Gymlib (100% borne by Voodoo)

 - Premium healthcare coverage SideCare, for your family 100% borne by Voodoo

 - Wellness activities in our Paris office
